name: Shader Authoring & Compilation
purpose: Author, optimize, cross-compile, and statically validate GPU shaders across modern shading languages (WGSL, HLSL, GLSL, and SPIR-V) with std140/std430 layout safety, warp divergence minimization, and pre-warmed pipeline caches.
inputs: Target graphics API & pipeline state requirements
Host data struct definitions and memory layout constraints
outputs: Validated, statically compiled shader bytecode / modules
Std140/std430 layout-aligned buffer definitions with explicit padding
Shader execution and divergence audit reports
stop_conditions: Task acceptance criteria satisfied with evidence
All shaders compile cleanly with zero errors under strict validation
All UBO/SSBO struct alignments adhere strictly to std140/std430 and host ABI
